criteria.observation: A near black foreground column still cuts through the right center of the wide frame and separates the hero from the action space.
Large rectangular overlays fill the medium frame, eliminate negative space, and read as an unordered pile instead of a designed mechanical assembly.
The close frame has more layers but the visor, eyes, brow, cheek, and jaw do not form a clear facial hierarchy or readable emotional beat.
Added parts project far from the underlying contour and compete at the same scale, increasing clutter rather than creating primary, secondary, and tertiary form hierarchy.
The cyan and coral lighting relationship and chamber depth remain visually coherent.

diagnosis.rootCause: The first typed executor optimized semantic part counts and minimum layers without screen space constraints for silhouette, negative space, contour adherence, or detail density.
diagnosis.prohibitedShortcut: Do not special case this project or manually place named parts.
